Added complex-valued unitary-transform and eigenvalue-preservation regression tests.
Module 13 reports full-covariance and polarimetric-symmetrization metadata when available.
GCOV MASK==0 invalid samples are propagated as NaN in affected Gamma0 visualization/polarimetric paths.
Modules 07 and 08 include corrected quality-control imports and VVVV/VHVH masking behavior.
Modules 15-17 use memory-conscious processing for large LSAR Full-Pol areas of interest.
Module 16 performs Cloude-Pottier H/A/alpha analysis in a tile-wise workflow.
Module 17 handles Yamaguchi volume-model outputs robustly and uses bounded RGB display scaling.
Clean public repository excludes Python/pytest cache artifacts and mission data products.
